subject.title: feat(ios): replace the tab bar with a black overlay sidebar (web parity + dashboard)

question: Should the iPhone app permanently replace its four-tab root navigation with the black sidebar drawer after the session-roster freshness defect is repaired?
rationale: The branch changes the primary navigation model for existing iPhone users; code review can verify behavior but cannot determine whether that permanent product direction is accepted.

options.title: Approve the sidebar direction after repair
options.body: Keep the shared iOS/iPad sidebar model, require the session-refresh fix and regression coverage, then review the rebuilt phone navigation as the new default.

options.title: Retain tabs on compact phones
options.body: Keep the existing phone tab shell and limit sidebar parity work to iPad or an additive compact-phone entry point.

recommendation.title: Approve the sidebar direction after repair
recommendation.body: Keep the shared iOS/iPad sidebar model, require the session-refresh fix and regression coverage, then review the rebuilt phone navigation as the new default.
